Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.android

Class AndroidSqliteDriver

java.lang.Object
org.aristonis.diwan.database.android.AndroidSqliteDriver
All Implemented Interfaces:
Driver
public final class AndroidSqliteDriver extends Object implements Driver
A driver over Android's SQLiteDatabase, for Android 9 (API 28) and later.

Every session shares the one database; Android serializes access to it, and a session never closes it, since the application owns its lifecycle. Pass the driver to Connection.builder().driver(...) and use the SQLite schema grammar for migrations. Turn foreign keys on with SQLiteDatabase.setForeignKeyConstraintsEnabled(boolean), for example in SQLiteOpenHelper.onConfigure.

      public static AndroidSqliteDriver of(android.database.sqlite.SQLiteOpenHelper helper)
      Creates a driver over a helper's writable database.

      The database is opened on first use, not here, since opening runs the helper's onCreate or onUpgrade; use the driver off the main thread.
